Aiming.name: Aiming
Aiming.description: If the character forgoes taking a movement action this round in favor of aiming for vitals, each shot they fire deals a minimum of 8 base damage.

Overcharged Shot.name: Overcharged Shot
Overcharged Shot.description: The character makes an altered strike. If it hits, they add their weapon's damage dice to their strike an additional time for every rank.

Piercing Attack.name: Piercing Attack
Piercing Attack.description: The next successful strike ignores anything that would reduce its damage and bypasses (ignoring them) temporary barriers. This skill does not affect immunity.

Pierce Cover.name: Pierce Cover
Pierce Cover.description: For every rank purchased, all strikes ignore up to 6'' of stone and wood, 3" of iron and steel, or 1" of adamantite, and 2 shield DVs until the start of their next turn. This ability does not allow attacks to ignore armor DVs.

Pinpoint.name: Pinpoint
Pinpoint.description: For every rank purchased, the character gains a placed roll to a single strike they make this turn.

Punchthrough.name: Punchthrough
Punchthrough.description: The altered strike cuts through all foes in a line until colliding with a physical or magical barrier. The character makes a single attack roll and then makes a single damage roll against all targets successfully struck, adding any applicable bonuses from other rifle specialization skills and lethal to all successfully struck.
